body: Our grandparent frames are personalized picture frames for the grandma and grandpa in your family, whatever the grandkids call them. Mimi, Gigi, Nana, Grammy, Oma, Papa, Pop, Grandad, Abuela: every word on the frame can be changed, so the name on it is the name they actually answer to. Each one is made to order, in a rounded rectangle or scalloped shape, with 44 backgrounds to choose from.

These frames make an easy gift from the grandkids for Mother’s Day and Father’s Day, and for birthdays, Grandparents Day and Christmas. A personalized grandma picture frame also makes a sweet first gift from a new baby, with a photo from the hospital or the first visit home. If both grandparents share a shelf, one frame can carry both names.

Not sure what to write? Keep it short and let the photo do the rest. A few ideas: “I Love My Mimi” across the top. “Happy Birthday Papa” with “Love, the Grandkids” along the bottom. “Nana’s Little Girl” or “Grandpa’s Buddy” for a photo with one grandchild. “Gigi and Me” for a matching-pajamas photo. You can also run the grandkids’ names down the left and right sides, add the year a new grandbaby arrived, or leave any side blank for a cleaner look. Long names are fine: text shrinks to fit its side, and the live preview on each page shows exactly how your frame will print before you buy.

The frame is about 8.4 by 6.4 inches, with an opening for a 4x6 photo behind glass and an easel back so it stands on a shelf, a desk or a nightstand. It ships without a photo. Print a favorite and slip it in before you wrap it, or give the frame on its own and let grandma pick the picture. Every frame is made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, and shipping is free in the US.
faq: What names can I put on a grandparent frame?
Any name at all: Mimi, Gigi, Nana, Papa, Pop, Abuela, Oma or a name only your family uses. Type it in and the preview shows it on the frame.
Can one frame be from all the grandkids?
Yes. Put “Love, the Grandkids” along the bottom, or list each grandchild’s name down the sides. Text shrinks to fit, and the preview shows exactly how it prints.
Which design suits Mother’s Day or Father’s Day?

The scalloped shape with a soft pattern suits a lot of grandmas, and the rounded rectangle with a wood or stripe background suits a lot of grandpas. Every design can be changed for either, so go with what fits their home.
Can I add the year they became grandparents?
Yes. Use a side for “Est. 2026” or the year the first grandbaby arrived, or add a new grandchild’s birth date.
Can I make matching frames for each grandparent?
Yes. Order one frame per grandparent with their own name, or one frame for both with “Mimi and Papa” across the top.
When should I order for Mother’s Day or Christmas?
Frames are made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, then travel to you by mail. Order as early as you can before the holiday so there’s time to add the photo and wrap it.

body: A pregnancy announcement frame for grandparents is one of the sweetest ways to tell your parents a baby is on the way. Wrap it, hand it over, and watch them read it. These ultrasound picture frames for grandparents are made for that moment, whether it’s their first grandchild or their fifth. The same frame works for great-grandparents, and for aunts and uncles too.

Use one for an in-person reveal at a holiday dinner, a birthday or a Sunday visit. They work for long-distance family as well: mail the frame and ask them to open it on a video call. If you’re telling both sets of grandparents, a matching frame for each keeps it fair. Afterward it stays on their shelf as a keepsake from the day they found out.

The words do the reveal, so make them easy to read in one look. A promoted to grandparents frame is a sweet classic: “Promoted to Grandparents” across the top with “Coming 2027” along the bottom. Other ideas: “Grandma and Grandpa Est. 2027”, “See You Soon, Grandpa” in the baby’s voice, or “Promoted to Great Grandma” for the generation above. Swap in the names you hope they’ll be called, like Mimi and Pop. Add the due month or season on one side, or leave the sides blank so the scan stands out. If you don’t know whether it’s a boy or a girl yet, “Baby Coming 2027” keeps it simple. Every word can be changed, text shrinks to fit, and the live preview shows exactly how the frame will print.

The frame is about 8.4 by 6.4 inches, with glass, an easel back and an opening for a 4x6 photo. It ships without a photo, ready for your ultrasound. Have the scan printed at 4x6, or use a bump photo, the positive test, or a picture of the two of you holding the sonogram. Each grandparent pregnancy announcement frame is made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, with free shipping in the US.
faq: What should a grandparent pregnancy announcement say?
Keep it short enough to read at a glance. “Promoted to Grandparents” with the due year on the bottom is clear and sweet, and you can swap in the names they’ll go by.
Can I use it to tell great-grandparents?
Yes. Change the top to “Promoted to Great Grandma”, “Great Grandpa” or “Great Grandparents” for both.
Will my ultrasound photo fit?
The opening holds a 4x6 photo. Have the scan printed at 4x6 and slip it behind the glass when the frame arrives.
Should I put the due date on it?
You can use the full date, a month or just the year. If the reveal is early, a season like “Coming Spring 2027” keeps it simple.
Can I order one for each set of grandparents?
Yes. Each frame is personalized on its own, so give each set the names they’ll be called. The preview shows every version before you buy.
How far ahead should I order for a holiday reveal?

Frames are made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, then travel to you by mail. If the reveal is planned for a holiday or birthday, order early so the frame is in hand with time to wrap it.

body: Godparent frames are personalized picture frames for two moments: asking someone to be a godparent, and thanking them on the baptism or christening day. A godmother proposal frame asks the question for you. A godmother picture frame or godfather picture frame says thank you from the baby, and there’s one for both godparents together. Each frame is made to order.

Give a proposal frame well before the baptism, with a photo of the baby or the ultrasound. Give a thank-you frame on the day or soon after, with a photo from the church or the party. Godparent frames also make good birthday and Christmas gifts from a godchild, and a first communion is a natural time to give a new one.

For a proposal, a question works best: “Will You Be My Godmother?” or “Will You Be My Godfather?” in the baby’s voice, with the baby’s name along the bottom. For a baptism gift, try “Godmothers Are a Blessing” with “Love, Your Godchild”, “Thank You for Saying Yes”, or the godchild’s name and baptism date on the sides. You can write Madrina and Padrino instead, or a nickname like Nina and Nino. Every word on the frame can be changed, any side can be left blank, and the live preview shows exactly how it prints.

The frame is about 8.4 by 6.4 inches, in a rounded rectangle or scalloped shape, with 44 backgrounds. It holds a 4x6 photo behind glass and has an easel back to stand on a shelf. It ships without a photo, so add a newborn photo for the proposal, or leave it for the godparents to fill with a picture from the day. If you’re shopping for godparents gifts that feel personal, this is one they can keep out all year. Frames are made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, and shipping is free in the US.
faq: What do I write on a will you be my godmother frame?
Ask in the baby’s voice: “Will You Be My Godmother?” across the top and the baby’s name along the bottom. Add the due date if the baby isn’t here yet.
Is there a godfather proposal frame?
Yes. Open any godparent design and change the top to “Will You Be My Godfather?”, or ask both at once with “Will You Be My Godparents?”
Which frame is for a baptism or christening gift?
The godmother, godfather and godparents baptism frames are made for thanking them on the day. Add the godchild’s name and baptism date, and frame a photo from the service.
Can I write Madrina, Padrino or a nickname?
Yes. Every word can be changed, so write Madrina, Padrino, Nina, Nino or whatever your family says.
Can one frame be for both godparents?
Yes. The godparents baptism frame is made for two, or you can put both names along the bottom of any design.
When should I order a proposal frame?

Asking well before the baptism gives everyone time to plan. Frames are made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, then travel by mail, so order early if you’re asking at a family gathering.

body: Our wedding frames are personalized picture frames for the people who got you to the altar. A father of the bride picture frame for the dad who walked you down the aisle. A mother of the groom frame to thank the groom’s mom. Thank-you frames for both sets of parents, and engagement frames for the couple. Each one is made to order.

Some couples hand out the parents’ frames at the rehearsal dinner or on the morning of the wedding, when there’s a quiet minute. Others wait until after the honeymoon and give them with a favorite photo from the day. As a wedding gift for parents, a frame is something they’ll keep out long after the flowers are gone. Engagement frames suit a bridal shower, an engagement party or a first home.

Write it the way you’d say it. For dad: “Dad, I Loved You First” with “Love, the Bride” on the bottom, or “Forever Your Little Girl” with the wedding date. For the groom’s mom: “Thank You for Raising the Man I Love”, or from the groom, “Mom, You Were My First Love”. For both sets of parents: “Thank You for Everything” with the family name. For the couple: “Mr. & Mrs.” with their new last name, or “Est. 2027” and the date. Every word can be changed and any side can be left blank. Text shrinks to fit, and the live preview shows exactly how it prints.

The frame is about 8.4 by 6.4 inches and holds a 4x6 photo behind glass, with an easel back to stand on a shelf or a mantel. It ships without a photo. Before the wedding, frame an old photo of the two of you, like a childhood picture with dad. After, swap in the father-daughter dance or a family portrait. Frames are made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, with free shipping in the US.
faq: What should a father of the bride frame say?
Something he’ll hear in your voice. “Dad, I Loved You First” is a classic, and “Forever Your Little Girl” with the wedding date works too.
Is there a mother of the groom frame?
Yes. The mother of the groom picture frame thanks the groom’s mom, and you can sign it from the bride, the groom or both.
Can I thank both sets of parents?
Order one frame for each set with their own names on it, since each frame is personalized on its own. “Thank You for Everything” works for either side.
Should I give it before or after the wedding?
Either works. Before, frame a childhood photo and give it at the rehearsal dinner or that morning. After, frame a photo from the wedding itself.
Can I add our wedding date?
Yes. Put it on the bottom or a side, written however you like: 6.12.2027, June 12, 2027, or just the year.
How early should I order before the wedding?
Frames are made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, then travel to you by mail. Order with time to spare before the rehearsal dinner. Wording can change until the frame goes to print.

body: Aunt and uncle frames are personalized picture frames for the aunt who keeps everyone’s secrets and the uncle who shows up for every game. An aunt picture frame or uncle picture frame can carry their real name or the one the kids use: Auntie, Aunt Jo, Auntie Bee, Uncle Bear. They make an easy, personal gift from a niece or nephew, and each one is made to order.

Birthdays and Christmas are the usual reasons, along with Mother’s Day for an aunt who’s like a second mom. A new aunt or uncle frame is a sweet way to share a pregnancy, and the same frame can ask an uncle to be godfather. Great aunts and great uncles deserve one too, with a photo of the whole crew. A frame from a new baby, with a photo of the first meeting, is a lovely way to welcome a brand new aunt or uncle.

Ideas to start from: “Best Uncle Ever” with “Happy Birthday” on the bottom. “Auntie and Me” for a photo with one niece or nephew. “Uncle’s Little Buddy” or “Love You, Auntie”. “Promoted to Aunt” with the due year, for a reveal. “Great Aunt Linda” with the kids’ names down the sides. Every word can be changed, any side can be left blank, and text shrinks to fit. The live preview shows exactly how the frame will print, so you can try a few versions before you buy.

The frame is about 8.4 by 6.4 inches, in a rounded rectangle or scalloped shape, with 44 backgrounds that run from checks and stripes to toile and wood looks. It holds a 4x6 photo behind glass, with an easel back to stand on a shelf or a desk. It ships without a photo, so you can add a recent one before you give it. Frames are made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, and shipping is free in the US.
faq: Can I write Auntie or a nickname?
Yes. Every word can be changed, so use Auntie, Aunt Jo, Uncle Bear or whatever the kids call them.
Can one frame be for an aunt and uncle together?
Yes. Put both names across the top, like “Aunt Jo and Uncle Sam”, or keep the top general and add their names on the sides.
What can a niece or nephew write?
Short and personal reads best: “Love You, Auntie”, “Best Uncle Ever” or an inside joke. Sign it along the bottom with the child’s name.
Does it work for a great aunt or great uncle?
Yes. Write Great Aunt or Great Uncle with their name, and add the kids’ names down the sides.
Can I use it to tell my sibling they’ll be an aunt or uncle?
Yes. “Promoted to Aunt” or “Promoted to Uncle” with the due year, plus an ultrasound photo, makes the reveal.
How far ahead should I order for a birthday?
Frames are made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, then travel by mail. Order a little ahead of the birthday so it arrives with time to wrap.

body: Our baby frames are personalized picture frames for the first photos of a new life: the sonogram, the newborn photo, the first picture home. Choose a sonogram picture frame for a pregnancy reveal, a twins ultrasound frame for double news, or a baby name picture frame with the name and birth date. Each frame is made to order.

Expecting parents use them for pregnancy announcements and nursery shelves. Friends and family give them at baby showers and as a new baby gift. An ultrasound frame also makes a sweet gift for a grandma-to-be, and when the baby arrives the same frame can hold a newborn photo instead. A baby name frame also suits a christening or a first birthday, with a favorite photo from the year.

For a scan: “Love at First Sight” with “Baby Due 2027” on the bottom, “Hello, Little One”, or “Double the Love” with “Twins Due 2027” for two. For a newborn: “Welcome to the World” with the baby’s name, or the name across the top with the birth date, time and weight down the sides. For the nursery, the name alone looks lovely. Every word can be changed and any side can be left blank. Text shrinks to fit, and the live preview shows exactly how it prints, so you can see the name in each font before you choose.

The opening fits a 4x6 photo behind glass. The frame measures about 8.4 by 6.4 inches, comes in a rounded rectangle or scalloped shape with 44 backgrounds, and stands on an easel back on a dresser or nursery shelf. It ships without a photo, so print the ultrasound or newborn photo at 4x6 and slip it in. Both shapes suit a nursery, and the backgrounds run from soft blues and sunny yellow checks to toile. Frames are made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, with free shipping in the US.
faq: Will my ultrasound photo fit?
The opening holds a 4x6 photo. Have the scan printed at 4x6 so it fills the opening.
Can I add birth stats to a baby name frame?
Yes. Put the name on top and the date, time, weight or length on the sides. Text shrinks to fit, and the preview shows how it all prints.
Do you have a frame for twins?
Yes. The twins ultrasound frame is made for two, with room for both names or the due date.
Can I order before the baby has a name?
Yes. Use the due date or “Little One” for now. Wording can change until the frame goes to print, so reply to your receipt if a name is chosen before then.
What should I write on a baby shower gift?
The baby’s name if the parents have shared it, or their last name with “Welcome, Little One”. They can add their favorite photo once the baby arrives.
How early should I order for a baby shower?
Frames are made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, then travel by mail. Order a little ahead of the shower so it’s in hand to wrap.

body: A pet memorial picture frame gives a favorite photo a place to stay. These frames are for the dog or cat who was part of the family, with their name and their years around the photo. Some people order one for themselves. Others send one to a friend as a sympathy gift. Either way, it’s a quiet way to keep them close. Each frame is made to order.

There’s no right time. Some people want a frame right away; others wait until they’re ready to look through photos. A personalized dog loss frame or cat memorial frame can sit on a desk, on a bedside table, beside a collar, or near the spot where they liked to nap.

Simple words usually feel right. Their name across the bottom, with their years on the sides, like 2012 on the left and 2026 on the right. Across the top, you might write “Forever in Our Hearts”, “Always Our Good Boy”, “Our Sweet Girl”, “Until We Meet Again” or, for a rainbow bridge picture frame, “Waiting at the Rainbow Bridge”. You can also leave the top blank and let the name stand on its own. If you’re remembering two pets, both names fit across the bottom. Every word can be changed, text shrinks to fit, and the live preview shows exactly how the frame will print, so you can take your time getting it right.

The frame holds a 4x6 photo behind glass, measures about 8.4 by 6.4 inches, and stands on an easel back. It comes in a rounded rectangle or scalloped shape, with 44 backgrounds from soft whitewashed wood to quiet stripes. It ships without a photo. If it’s a gift, the person you’re sending it to can choose the picture, or you can print one you know they love. Frames are made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, and shipping is free in the US.
faq: What should I write on a pet memorial frame?
Their name and years are enough. If you’d like a line on top, “Forever in Our Hearts” or “Until We Meet Again” are gentle choices.
Can I use their nickname?
Yes. Every word can be changed, so use the name you called them every day, nicknames included.
Is it only for dogs?
No. Every word can be changed, so it works for a cat, a horse, a rabbit or any pet you loved.
Can I write rainbow bridge wording?
Yes. “Waiting at the Rainbow Bridge” or “See You at the Rainbow Bridge” fits across the top, with their name below.
Can I send it to a friend as a sympathy gift?
Yes. Add their pet’s name and years and send it as is, and your friend can slip in their own photo. We ship to US addresses only.
How soon will the frame ship?
Each frame is made to order and shipped within 3 to 5 business days, with free shipping in the US. If you need to change the wording after ordering, reply to your receipt before it goes to print.
Can I add the grandkids’ names?
Yes. Put them along the bottom or down the sides. Text shrinks to fit, and the preview shows exactly how it prints.
Can I change Mimi to another name?
Yes. Every word can be changed, so it works for Gigi, Grammy or any name she goes by.
Can I order one for Mimi and Papa together?
Yes. Write “Mimi and Papa” across the top, or pair it with our Papa picture frame.
What should a Nana frame say?
Short lines read best: “Nana and Me”, “Nana’s Little Girl” or “We Love You, Nana”, with the grandkids’ names on the bottom.
Can I add the year she became Nana?
Yes. Put “Est. 2026” or the first grandchild’s birth year on one side.
Does it work for a brand new Nana?
Yes. Frame a photo from the hospital or the first visit, and add the baby’s name and birth date on the sides.
What should a Papa frame say?
“I Love My Papa”, “Papa’s Buddy” or “Happy Father’s Day, Papa” all fit, with the grandkids’ names on the bottom.
Can I change Papa to Pop, Grandad or Abuelo?
Yes. Every word can be changed. Our grandpa picture frame is another place to start if he goes by Grandpa.
Which shape suits a grandpa?
Both work. The rounded rectangle with a wood or stripe background is a simple choice, and the preview shows each one with your words.
Can I write the frame in Spanish?
Yes. Every word can be changed, so try “Te Quiero, Abuela” across the top and “Con Amor, Tus Nietos” on the bottom, or mix English and Spanish.
Can I use Abuelita or another name?
Yes. Write the name she answers to, like Abuelita, Lita or Buela. The preview shows exactly how it prints.
Is there a matching frame for Abuelo?
Any of our grandpa frames can say Abuelo. Open the Papa picture frame and change the name.
What should a mother of the groom frame say?
From the bride: “Thank You for Raising the Man I Love”. From the groom: “Mom, You Were My First Love”. Add the wedding date on the bottom.
Can I change it for the mother of the bride?
Yes. Every word can be changed, so it works for either mom. For dad, see our father of the bride wedding frame.
When should I give it to her?
The rehearsal dinner or the morning of the wedding are both good moments. Frame an old photo of her with the groom, and she can swap in a wedding photo later.
